title: Sci-Fi or Animation
statementMd:
List titles whose genre is either Sci-Fi or Animation.

Expected columns: `title`, `genre`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT title, genre FROM movies WHERE genre IN ('Sci-Fi', 'Animation');
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
